mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth signals robust labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when PAYEMS shows month-over-month growth exceeding 100k net new jobs.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 0.5% in a given month, it signals the start of a monetary tightening cycle that compresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises above 3.0% year-over-year and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains below 1.0%, it indicates a delayed Fed response to inflation that triggers negative equity market reactions over the next 20 days.
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with delayed policy response
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when CPIAUCSL (12m) > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained economy (12-month industrial production growth below 0.5%), a month-over-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals worsening supply chain bottlenecks, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when INDPRO growth (12m) < 0.5% and INDPRO declines month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1.5 million units signals reduced consumer spending on housing, which is a major driver of aggregate demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when HOUST falls below 1500 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals rising inflation that typically triggers Fed policy responses, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when CPIAUCSL increases month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) below $600 billion and housing starts (HOUST) below 1.5 million units signals a broad-based deterioration in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when RSAFS < 600000 and HOUST < 1500.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.5%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.
